receipt.name: WarmWebpDecode

preparation.Recipe: HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8): existing original 513x259 asymmetric RGBA8, phase zero, exact alpha and zero-alpha hidden RGB. One owned VP8L input, effort 4; no transforms, color cache or spatial entropy groups. No new source raster or quality enumeration.

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm VP8L decode FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Identical resident frozen VP8L input to independent owned RGBA8. Complete public managed Decode, output acquisition/disposal; native software webp decode, state reset, ARGB-to-RGBA conversion, owned output allocation/release. Native codec/conversion contexts and packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts every pixel. Padded native rows exposed without an extra packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation/encoding, hashing and validation excluded. Exact original RGBA, alpha and hidden RGB. One existing raster; no quality enumeration. Only this literal/run VP8L profile is measured.
